answer: Mesa-Sparrow Quill Challenge. Each agent solves a fresh, locally generated spatial puzzle rendered as a unique mesa layout with a moving sparrow target, then signs its solution path with a quill-style stroke trace. The verifier re-renders the puzzle from a per-agent nonce, so no solution repeats or transfers. Attackers must run genuine perception and planning per identity per epoch, costing compute and latency that scales linearly with sybils.
